events.title: Your Next Run Goes Portable: Steam Deck & Gamepad Support!
events.summary: Runners, get ready to take your next run beyond the desktop!We're bringing Steam Deck, SteamOS, and gamepad support to NeoRunners! Build your deck, unleash devastating combos, and battle through a comic-book cyberpunk world—on the go or from your couch.We're refining controller navigation to make every card, combo, and tactical decision feel intuitive.Stay tuned for updates, and wishlist NeoRunners on Steam!Your deck. Your controller. Your next run.

events.title: NeoRunners Demo V2 Out NOW!
events.summary: NeoRunners Demo V2 is OUT! Go test it, feels like a much improved game! This update is all about feel. We went through a full run, from the title screen to the last loot drop, and fixed every spot where the game stuttered, hid something or kept you waiting. Smoother From Start to FinishOne clean transition. Scene changes are now a single comic-ink wipe, and it only lifts once the next screen is fully ready.Instant runner select.
